title: Pipe chart finds WinCan Picture and Reports folders
description:
View PDF / View Photos on the pipe chart now work on both billable packages (Videos / Reports / Images) and raw WinCan job folders (Video / Picture / REPORTS…). Folder names are matched case-insensitively, including names like REPORTS 5-7-26.

The job project folder is loaded automatically so buttons can appear without browsing into Picture or Misc first.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing inspections on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart accepts WinCan Picture / Photos aliases for Images.
Pipe chart treats folders named Reports… (e.g. REPORTS 5-7-26) as report folders.
Job project subtree hydrates automatically for PDF and photo buttons.
